summary: Rendering#1467 adds one self-contained instanceAppearanceControl through the existing compiled replaceHostedBenchmarkDocument seam, invoked verbatim by the self-running document control and the normal packed-browser page.evaluate caller. Ten fixed public units use both shared-symbol and expanded-geometry representations; one transitions through initial, faction switch, health zero, health ten, outline addition, outline removal, combined appearance/translation, identical repeat and restoration. Independent DOM oracles check faction reference/colour, geometry, part order, semantic hit identity, live/export equivalence and exact per-state rectangle population. Definitions and nine unrelated complete subtrees retain identity/markup and zero scoped MutationObserver records, including parent-recorded moves. Target baseline descendants survive, removed outlines detach and identical replacement emits no records. Selection adds/removes four rectangles; shared symbols also retain their ten transparent viewport hit proxies. Thus unchanged node-count assertions across selection would be wrong, while documentHit is semantic routing and is not painted-pixel/GPU proof. Source contains actual DOM stale faction/health/outline, unrelated clone/move and redundant-write controls, restores deliberate changes, disconnects observers and restores the original document without replacing the first failure. Existing suite-control-test executes the actual two caller expressions at inert boundaries and contains omission/window/witness/receipt/await mutants; source wiring alone cannot substitute for actual compiled execution. This record captures the source design only: Node controls, compiled self-running and Chromium/Firefox/WebKit qualification, exact independent review, required CI and protected delivery were not established by this capture. Program.fs, calibrated hosted harness/workload/manifest and workflow bytes remain unchanged. The full SVG parent .3-.8, performance, licensed-glyph, GPU, publication and adoption assertions remain distinct.
title: Per-instance appearance needs both semantic and noninterference witnesses
